title: O Dell Group LLC Has $7.53 Million Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
O Dell Group LLC cut its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.8% in the third quarter, Holdings Channel reports. The institutional investor owned 33,358 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,302 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up about 4.9% of O Dell Group LLC’s holdings, making the stock its 10th largest holding. O Dell Group LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $7,530,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC.
A number of other institutional investors have also added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Clearwater Capital Advisors LLC lifted its position in Apple by 1.4% during the 1st quarter. Clearwater Capital Advisors LLC now owns 23,864 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,004,000 after acquiring an additional 332 shares during the last quarter. FCG Advisors LLC lifted its position in Apple by 24.1% during the 1st quarter. FCG Advisors LLC now owns 27,444 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,605,000 after acquiring an additional 5,329 shares during the last quarter. First Pacific Advisors LLC lifted its position in Apple by 24.1% during the 1st quarter. First Pacific Advisors LLC now owns 17,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,852,000 after acquiring an additional 3,300 shares during the last quarter. Asset Management One Co. Ltd. lifted its position in Apple by 1.2% during the 1st quarter. Asset Management One Co. Ltd. now owns 8,511,252 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,428,018,000 after acquiring an additional 99,807 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Koch Industries Inc. lifted its position in Apple by 36.8% during the 1st quarter. Koch Industries Inc. now owns 4,734 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $794,000 after acquiring an additional 1,274 shares during the last quarter. NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $148.26 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $142.00 and a 12-month high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a current ratio of 1.12 and a quick ratio of 1.09. The stock has a market capitalization of $775.31 billion, a P/E ratio of 12.45, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.21 and a beta of 1.23. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business posted $2.07 earnings per share. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. Equities analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 13.18 EPS for the current fiscal year.
AAPL has been the subject of a number of research analyst reports. UBS Group started coverage on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 12th. Maxim Group upped their price objective on shares of Apple to $221.00 and gave the company an “average” rating in a research report on Thursday, September 13th. Royal Bank of Canada upped their price objective on shares of Apple to $250.00 and gave the company an “average” rating in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. Morgan Stanley set a $245.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, September 11th. Finally, Bank of America upped their price objective on shares of Apple from $250.00 to $256.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, September 10th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have issued a hold rating and twenty-one have issued a buy rating to the company. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $195.64.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through the SEC website . Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
